specs.value: 22 W (230 V/50 Hz); US 120 V version listed at 23 W
4-stage: removable EasyClean pre-filter with activated-carbon foam, then foams of different porosity plus Hel-X bio media
Heater, filter media, hoses, connectors and intake/outlet pipes
3 years, plus 1 more year with online registration
About 456 L/h at 80 cm head; about 15.7 W draw; max head measured at about 2.12 m
The Thermo models add a built-in 300 W HeatUp heater in the filter. The plain BioMaster/BioMaster 2 sold in Vietnam doesn't include a heater

prices.variant: BioMaster 600 ver2 (non-Thermo; contact shop to buy)

fits.fact: Rated for aquariums up to about 600 L

Because the heater is built into the filter, it suits tropical tanks that need warm water without a heater in the tank. Suggested settings are 24–26°C for community tanks, 22–26°C for planted tanks and 28–30°C for discus. Goldfish usually don't need heating
Vietnamese shops sell the BioMaster for planted, fish and shrimp tanks, and their spec tables use 600 L as the size limit for the 600
Real flow at typical cabinet head height is much lower than the rated 1,250 L/h (about 456 L/h measured at 80 cm). Allow for this on large or heavily planted tanks

usage.fact: Put the canister below the tank's water level on a flat, stable surface, and leave space above it to open the lid
Keep hoses short and free of kinks, and check that the quick-release adapter locks
Priming: fill the tank first, open the valves, then press the prime button repeatedly until the canister fills. Only plug it in after that, and never run it dry
Some bubbles and gurgling on the first run are normal while trapped air clears. Check every seal for leaks
Rinse the EasyClean pre-filter every 2–4 weeks. Check the impeller and hoses every 2–3 months. Service the main media and O-rings every 4–6 months
The EasyClean pre-filter comes out on its own, so the main media can be left alone for longer
Flow can be adjusted at several points. Handle and pre-filter locks and one-way valves in the connector help prevent spills

issues.fact: The most common complaint is air getting into the canister. This sends bubbles into the tank, makes the impeller louder and can shorten its life. One buyer said a replacement pump from OASE had the same fault
One forum user had constant bubbles that eased when the filter was tilted with the heater lower, and suspected the O-ring on the top heater. Other owners say OASE later improved the design
Noise reports vary. Some owners found it a low, annoying hum, while others said it was quieter than an Eheim. One reviewer called it extremely quiet
Leaks tend to appear right after maintenance, so check the seals each time the filter is reopened
Vietnamese shops mostly sell the non-heated BioMaster 2, and their warranties differ: 1 year at Shrimp Home and Tạp Hóa Thủy Sinh versus 3 years claimed at Bích Phương. Removable parts are excluded

alternatives.why: Same 1,250 L/h and 1.8 m head with lower power use (16 W). It has an Xtender button to keep flow going when media clogs, a 3-year warranty from the official distributor, and costs about 7.45 million VND, which is cheaper than the BioMaster 600. It has no built-in heater
Same filter body without the heater, and the version easiest to find in Vietnamese shops (about 9.2–10.2 million VND). Pair it with a separate heater if needed
Higher flow (1,400 L/h) at 20 W with a large 12 L canister, for 160–600 L tanks. No Vietnamese shop price was found
